description:
Waypoint - TREK mate is the iPhone app for a TREK server you already run.

The Today tab is the day you are actually in. Stops sit in order, with the walk or ride to the next one, the booking that is coming up, and the place you sleep tonight. Weather for the next stop is one tap. The day's pins are on a map when you want them.

Leave the app. If you stay at a stop long enough, Waypoint marks it done and moves on. That uses your location, including while the app is closed. You can say no. The plan still works.

Costs are the other half. What the trip has cost, what you spent today, and, when you are splitting, who paid and who owes. Add an expense from the tab or from the widget. A Shortcut can send Apple Pay transactions on the trip into that same budget. Currency conversion uses public rates, so a receipt in another currency still lands in the trip's money.

The next stop also lives on the Home Screen and the Lock Screen.

You type in the address of your TREK server and sign in. Waypoint does not run that server. The person who made the app cannot open your trips, your expenses, or your location.
whatsNew:
Recaps now include the places you didn't plan. If photos from a day were taken somewhere that isn't on your itinerary, the recap adds that place in the order you visited it. Pick it from nearby suggestions or search for it, and it's saved to your Journey without changing your plan.

Also new since the last update:
- Daily recaps with suggested photos, reminders, and journal drafts written with Apple Intelligence where available
- Packing lists organized into bags
- Look Around for the places on your day
- Your active trip's stops and bookings in Spotlight

Fixes:
- When you skip a stop, Today and the Live Activity now move on to the next one instead of pointing back at the stop you skipped
- The Apple Pay shortcut reads payment amounts and currencies correctly, and its setup now opens Automations and explains how to set it to Run Immediately
- Settings and other screens scroll and respond to taps again on iOS 26
